text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHH!!
I DIIIIIIIIID IIIIIIIIITTT!!
A voice, trembling with emotion yet brimming with strength, echoed across Nakayama.

Meisho Doto finally surpassed TM Opera O and all the
other formidable rivals, shining at the absolute pinnacle!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Impossible... For the Supreme Overlord to be defeated,
even while at the absolute peak of her form...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yet... if I am to fall in this state, I would have no regrets—!
This is a miracle, the ultimate creation of drama!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Alright...! Yes! Yeees, yeeeeeesss!
Trainer, I did it!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm sparkling! I'm a strong girl!!
That unconfident me is nowhere to be found anymore!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHN,
WAAAAAHHHHHHNN!!
choice_data_list: Don't cry, you're tough, aren't you?
Don't cry, you're a strong girl, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaaaaahn!!
Waaaaaaaahhhhhhhhhn!!

The more I tried to comfort her,
the harder Meisho Doto wept, like a fire
that refused to go out.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Grass-chan, that was a bit unexpected.
I found myself looking over at Opera O-san...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Right~ We were completely overruled.
Still, though~

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "That was... our own immaturity. A mistake no amount of regret could ever undo..."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"She had been there—all along,
in that very place."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Right behind the eye-catching Opera O,
quietly harboring a magnificent talent.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Everyone overlooked it. Everyone underestimated it.
And yetâ

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
There were those who recognized that talent.
And took their time to let it blossom—
bigger than anyone else's.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If we write off this defeat as a mere coincidence,
we will surely repeat the same mistake.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
“—The evening primrose.
So deeply rooted, so vivid.”

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: For this year—the strongest Umamusume who stood at our pinnacle... is without a doubt Meisho Doto.
And then—the awards ceremony.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: H-H-H-Hello, I'm Meisho Dotoo...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I ran, I cried, and blabbed so much nonsense to you today, Trainer, that I don't really remember much of it~

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad... we won...
Um... could I speak with you for just a moment?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
In the past, I had no confidence in myself
because I was hopeless at everything I did...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Still, as I competed in races, I started to like myself just a little bit more...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Even though I won today, I still can't quite feel confident in myself.
Maybe it means I still have a long way to go.

I started racing because I wanted to gain confidence.
Even so, the destination still seems far away.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Still, I'm really glad I started running.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm clumsy, useless, and I can't even give up properly,
nor can I speak well, but...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Still, but even so, please let me say just this one last thing!
Meisho Doto took a deep breath in—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Even if you're at rock bottom!
Even if you can't stand yourself!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Confidence? Not at all! Not one bit!
Even if I have zero, zero, zero, zero confidence—!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Salvation does exist!!
A furious, surging roar—almost bordering on a cry.
And so, the horse girl who sought salvation from the depths of despair achieved greatness—and became a salvation for others.
